title: Operation list
description: The operations a step record can name: for each, its kind, how it takes its inputs, its one fixed policy, whether it writes a new variable, the unit it produces, the coverage it records, and the data gaps it can leave out with what each counts.

kind.description: `retrieval` reads a version; `analysis` is one of the analysis engine's operations; `source_pipeline` is a step the source's pipeline applied before the DFO read the data; `mint_choice` is a choice the DFO made while minting a version; `card_selection` is what a card draws from its version; `card_derivation` is a value a card derives from what it draws.

input.description: `single`: one `input`. `roles`: `inputs` keyed by the names in `roles`. `none`: the step takes no input, since it records a choice inside the version being made.

new_variable.description: Whether the operation writes its rows under a new variable, which its step names in `stat_var`. An operation without one keeps the variables of its inputs.

rule.description: `as_recorded`: the unit the version holds. `same_as_input`: the input's unit, which every input must share. `composed`: the numerator's unit per the denominator's. `percent`: per cent. `same_as_input_or_dimensionless`: the input's unit for an absolute change, a dimensionless ratio for a relative one. `per_side`: each side keeps its own unit. `converted`: the unit converted into. `same_as_input_or_percent`: the input's unit for a difference, per cent for a percent change. `same_as_input_or_none`: the input's unit for a ranking of values, none for an ordinal ranking, whose values are rank positions.

coverage.description: `period_coverage`: how many entities each period's total covers. `entity_coverage`: how many periods each ranked entity holds. `null`: none.

left_out.description: The data gaps the operation can leave out. A step may name a reason this list lacks.

of.description: What a count under this reason can count.
